time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Average uranium tailings composition from literature references. Transfer coefficients from prospective model, specific to uranium tailings.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data refers to a worldwide average. Dataset contains the mixture of two different generic sites: 53% dry site (actual evaporation > precipitation) and 47% wet site (actual evaporation < precipitation), according to the worldwide uranium tailings production in 2006.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Mechanically stable tailings impoundment. Closure with clay barrier and reduction of leachate flow for the initial 2000 years. Uranium production from in-situ leaching (ISL) is not heedded.

# Included processes
Waste-specific emissions for uranium tailings impoundment leachate. Mixture of a generic dry site (53%) and generic wet site (47%). Short- and long-term emissions to air from dry site (wind erosion of evaporites). Short- and long-term emissions to groundwater from wet site (infiltration leaching).; Geography: Data refers to a worldwide average. Dataset contains the mixture of two different generic sites: 53% dry site (actual evaporation > precipitation) and 47% wet site (actual evaporation < precipitation), according to the worldwide uranium tailings production in 2006.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Tailings model based on observed leachate concentrations in literature. Extrapolated to 80'000 years heeding chemical characteristics. Initial tailings composition from various literature sources.
